name: Interquel
storyline:
The traitor of the Immortals, Ye Jiming, in a moment of desperation to escape his pursuers, used the legendary Yeming Relic, a mythical artifact said to break through the barriers of three thousand worlds.

When Ye Jiming awakens once more, his eyes are met not only with a completely unfamiliar, otherworldly landscape, but also with familiar faces, seemingly bound to him by fate...
summary:
The traitor of the Immortals, Ye Jiming, in a desperate attempt to escape pursuit, used the legendary Yeming Relic, said to have the power to shatter the barriers between three thousand worlds.

When Ye Jiming awakens again, he finds himself surrounded not only by a completely unfamiliar otherworldly landscape, but also by strangely familiar faces, seemingly bound to him by fate...
